# Parvathi Vrushabha HR Solution LLP

> Bengaluru-based Human Resource and Workforce Solutions company. Strength in Service, Grace in Growth. We provide manpower services, staffing and placement, campus recruitment, facility management and housekeeping, payroll management, HR audits and statutory compliance support to businesses across industries.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Parvathi Vrushabha HR Solution LLP
- Established: 2026
- Leadership: Anithadevi E (Entrepreneur & Designated Director); Mr. Eshwarappa (Additional Designated Director, transport & travels entrepreneur since 1996)
- Location: No. 112, Raju Layout Main Road, 3rd Cross, Opp. Devaraj Urs Road, Nagadevanahalli, Jnanabharathi Post, Bengaluru – 560056, Karnataka, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70261 99239, +91 73531 88999
- Email: info@parvathivrushabha.com, hrd@parvathivrushabha.com
- Website: https://www.parvathivrushabha.com/
- Workforce supplied: skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled manpower (machine operators, technicians, production workers, helpers, drivers, housekeeping and office support staff)
- Industries: Manufacturing & Engineering; Retail & FMCG; Logistics & Supply Chain; Pharmaceutical / Healthcare; Hospitality; Facility Management; Warehousing & Distribution; Commercial Establishments; Service Industries
- Vision: To become a trusted and preferred HR, Staffing and Facility Management solutions partner by creating employment opportunities, developing workforce capabilities and supporting sustainable business growth.
- Mission: To deliver quality, reliable and cost-effective HR and workforce solutions through professional service, operational excellence, employee welfare and strong client relationships.

## Services
- [Campus Recruitment & Placement](https://www.parvathivrushabha.com/services/campus-recruitment-placement/): We help organizations connect with fresh talent from colleges and educational institutions through structured campus recruitment programs.
- [Specialized Manpower & Workforce Solutions](https://www.parvathivrushabha.com/services/manpower-workforce-solutions/): We provide reliable skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled manpower to support the operational requirements of different industries.
- [Facility Management & Housekeeping](https://www.parvathivrushabha.com/services/facility-management-housekeeping/): We provide customized housekeeping and facility management solutions based on the specific requirements of our clients.
- [Payroll Management & HR Compliance](https://www.parvathivrushabha.com/services/payroll-hr-compliance/): We support organizations in managing HR operations, payroll activities and statutory compliance requirements.
